paragraphs.text: Kzzy'n, the Dragon Lord was a warrior on Shandalar , who took command of the Red Guild until its downfall.

Kzzy'n's forces included sorcerers , sorceresses , troll shamans , goblin lords , hydras , war mages , ape lords , sedge beasts , centaur warchiefs , elementalists , Queltosh djinni and Dracur dragons .

The guildlords and the guilds themselves were originally of pure intent to defend Shandalar but were corrupted by the evil Planeswalker Arzakon 's influence in the guise of a benevolent advisor. Together, they betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar during Arzakon's War , to open the path for Arzakon.
The Guildlords, including Kzzy'n, were in turn defeated, and Arzakon was banned from entering the plane.
